workshoptitle: Adopt EPCM: Migrate a Legacy Profitability and Cost Management Application

tutorials.title: Get Started
tutorials.description: Prerequisites: a source PCM environment and a separate empty EPCM target environment, both with Service Administrator access.

tutorials.title: Introduction
tutorials.description: About this workshop and how to choose your adoption path.

tutorials.title: Common Lab 1: Enable the EPCM Business Process
tutorials.description: Preconfigure the target environment for Enterprise Profitability and Cost Management.

tutorials.title: Reference: EPCM Modeling Concepts
tutorials.description: A short read on models, rule sets, rules, and POVs.

tutorials.title: Path B Lab 2: Prepare and Generate the PCM Migration Template
tutorials.description: Clean up the source PCM application and generate the XML migration template.

tutorials.title: Path B Lab 3: Customize, Validate, and Run the PCM-to-EPCM Migration
tutorials.description: Edit the template, upload it, validate, and generate the snapshot or migrate directly.

tutorials.title: Path B Lab 4: Validate the Migrated Application and Complete Post-Migration Tasks
tutorials.description: Validate dimensions, models, and data, and plan the artifacts you must recreate.

tutorials.title: Optional Lab: Enable the PCM Agent
tutorials.description: Turn on the Generative AI assistant.

tutorials.title: Optional Lab: Use the PCM Agent
tutorials.description: Create sandbox modeling artifacts and calculate with natural language.

tutorials.title: Need Help?
tutorials.description: Solutions to common problems and directions for receiving live help.
